steps.code:
# Delete each of the 9 requests from yesterday and create new ones with amount reduced by $5
for req in yesterday_requests:
    # Delete the old request
    del_resp = apis.venmo.delete_payment_request(payment_request_id=req['payment_request_id'], access_token=access_token)
    print(f"Deleted {req['payment_request_id']}: {del_resp}")
    # Create new request with amount - 5
    new_amount = req['amount'] - 5
    create_resp = apis.venmo.create_payment_request(
        user_email=req['receiver']['email'],
        amount=new_amount,
        access_token=access_token,
        description=req['description'],
        private=req['private']
    )
    print(f"Created new for {req['receiver']['email']} amount {new_amount}: {create_resp}")
